prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Generate a premium Japanese yarn-shop lifestyle editorial hero photograph, landscape 3:2, highest available resolution. Rebuild the previous basket scene with much stronger real inhabited-room depth and photographic sophistication. No text.

REFERENCE ROLES, in supplied path order: 1 Impression Sunrise authoritative green cake; 2 Handknit No.2 authoritative pastel variegated oval ball; 3 Oil Painting Boucle authoritative front unwrapped multicolor cake; 4 Xuebao authoritative foreground silver gray fuzzy ball; 5 Magic Ball authoritative peach-white-icy cyan feather cake. Product references override any stylization. Room references were inspected separately and their required atmosphere is described below. Brand terracotta #AB5631 is only an environment cue.

LAYOUT HARD CONSTRAINTS: left 55% is quiet softly evenly lit cream plaster for copy; entire top 14% is uninterrupted quiet cream plaster with no furniture, curtain, window, yarn or strong shadows. Basket fully inside frame lower right x=57–96%, y=57–94%, five yarns readable and not cropped. Left wall remains clear down to approximately y=77%, floor and rug may occupy bottom. Do not make safety area larger than necessary. Build depth in right 45% below y=18% and across bottom floor, not by filling copy area.

ROOM: a believable different corner of the reference craft room. A low aged honey oak cubby shelf recessed against the far-right BACK wall, top at y=26%, filled with a modest assortment of unlabelled cream, sage and gray yarn skeins in varied organic winding. Visible wall return and oblique floorboard perspective establish actual room depth. Shelf at least a meter behind the foreground basket. At far right a narrow cropped window alcove and softly folded unbleached linen curtain edge BEGIN BELOW y=18%, never entering top navigation strip. Only a small portion of oak armchair arm/leg, behind basket and partially cropped at right. Small plain terracotta ceramic cup on a worn low side table; a small loosely folded butter-yellow linen napkin beneath it. These restrained environment accents echo logo, never recolor yarn. No plants, vases, extra baskets, blankets or finished knit pieces. Prioritize floor-level basket as sole hero over furniture.

PRODUCTS: five normally sized retail yarn bundles naturally nestled in a low handwoven oval wicker basket on coarse jute rug, at different angles, lightly overlapping with credible weight:
Back-left compact cylindrical Oil Painting Boucle cake: dense tiny irregular curly loops and fine fuzz, NOT large bobbles or pompoms; deep leafy green and cobalt side sections, coral salmon, mustard and dusty pale blue top winding, closely match unwrapped reference cake.
Back-right Magic Ball tilted away a little: feather/eyelash gradient cake, peach-apricot center through pale blush and cream white to very pale icy cyan outer rim; discrete fine long fibers, translucent natural flyaways without glow. Preserve color transitions.
Front-left Impression Sunrise tilted green gradient cake: jade/sea green, mint and pale yellow-green cream, subtly irregular undulating center-pull winding matching reference, not decorative flower geometry, fine lightly hairy strands.
Front-right Xuebao: silver light dove-gray rounded oblong cross-wound center-pull ball, fine visible strands under long airy irregular fuzzy halo. Gray not purple. A short connected gray yarn end crosses basket rim and rests naturally on rug.
Center Handknit No.2: oblong commercial cross-wound soft plied ball lying diagonally, pastel peach/coral pink, butter yellow, mint/aqua, lavender sections along individual strands. Match actual reference oval winding, not a spherical rainbow candy or thick tubular cords. No labels.

LIGHT / PHOTOGRAPHY: real afternoon side-window daylight originating left/out of frame, neutral color rendition with gently warm wood. Broad soft light across copy wall, richer layered directional light and restrained elongated window-frame shadows across lower floor and right furniture ONLY; subtle reflected light under yarn and realistic dark contact shadows within basket. No orange grading. An oblique pool of sunlight catches a worn floorboard and uneven rug edge. Small oak wear marks, a subtle cup ring on side table, imperfect rug fibers, a few connected yarn tails convey ongoing handwork, no messy clutter. Detailed yet unforced editorial photograph, full-frame 50mm approximately f/4, foreground yarn sharply resolved with mild natural depth falloff into rear shelf while retaining room structure. Realistic scale, uninterrupted physically plausible wicker weave and continuous strands. Refined tonal range, no HDR sharpening, no fake vignette, no haze, no glowing fibers or light blobs. Not a studio product shot, not a blank catalog wall with props pasted on. No people, animals, letters, digits, labels, bands, logos, watermarks, UI.

FINAL CORRECTION — strict layout takes precedence: Pull camera far back, wide environmental photograph, NOT product close-up. Basket including all yarn must fit ENTIRELY inside x=58–96%, y=55–94%. No yarn or basket may cross x=55%. Left 55% must be cream wall through y=78%. Entire top 18% across ALL WIDTH must be blank cream wall, especially upper right. Use a genuinely LOW shelf with visible top BELOW y=27%; absolutely no tall shelves continuing beyond frame. REMOVE visible window and curtain if they cannot remain below y=25%; suggest offscreen window through light on lower floor instead. Lower the chair arm below y=38%. Room depth from low shelf receding behind basket and floor perspective, while upper wall remains empty. Fine boucle loops must be smaller and less bobble-like. Use only ONE basket in whole scene, no extra shelf baskets. Keep product identity, cup, yellow linen and natural sunlight. This correction is mandatory.

FINAL REFRAMING EDIT (input: second generated image):
Edit the attached photograph by reframing / outpainting, preserving its yarn identities, fibers, colors, sunlight, shelf, ceramic cup and room. Final landscape 3:2. Mandatory: shrink the entire existing photographed scene to 72% of its current linear size and anchor it at the BOTTOM RIGHT of the final canvas. Extend the same cream plaster wall seamlessly above and to the left, extend oak floor at bottom left. This yields the basket only in the lower-right approximately x=58–98%, y=56–95%, with no object in left 55% above y=78%. Ensure entire TOP 18% is EMPTY cream wall across full width: lower or remove uppermost chair arm if needed. No seams or borders. Keep a believable room view with rear low yarn shelf, terracotta cup and yellow linen, natural side window sunlight on floor. Preserve five yarn products exactly and sharp natural photographic texture. No text, no labels. Output 1536x1024 or higher with 3:2 ratio.
